title: Phase 118 publishes the canonical living encyclopedia
summary: Twenty-seven authored chapters connect the Published evidence shelf to historical baselines, conversion chains, contested interpretations, decisive evidence, and explicit claim boundaries.
evidence_note: The chapters synthesize existing Published signals and inherit their source lineage and limits. Editorial synthesis is not a new observation, causal finding, outcome, score, or ranking.
publication_effect: Adds 27 maintained encyclopedia chapters, an index, and one public data export without changing any underlying evidence state.
